diagnostics.intro: Trouble with Voltius? Create a report and send it to the developer — it helps track down bugs that are hard to reproduce.
diagnostics.verboseSub: Records extra detail to help diagnose issues. Resets to normal when you restart Voltius.
diagnostics.verboseHint:
Verbose logging is on. To capture the problem:
1. Reproduce the issue now
2. Come back and create a bug report
diagnostics.reportSub: Includes app logs and system info. Never includes your passwords, keys, or terminal contents.
diagnostics.includedBody:
Included:
• App logs (what Voltius was doing, with sensitive values removed)
• App version, operating system, and active plugins
NOT included:
• Passwords, vault contents, or private keys
• Terminal output or anything you typed
The report is saved to your computer. Nothing is sent automatically — you choose where to share it.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.sub: Lets local MCP clients (like Claude Code) run commands, read, write and delete files on every host in your vault and on this computer, and create, change or delete saved connections, keys and identities, over a private socket. Approval happens in that client, not in Voltius. Off by default.

quickSetup.help: Configures every AI agent it detects on this computer, without touching your other settings. Requires Node.js.

manualSetup.toggleSub: No Node.js installed, or your client isn't supported by the command above? Set it up by hand below.

help.claudeCode: Run this once to register Voltius with Claude Code. The server must be enabled above for a client to connect.
help.mcpServers: Add this block to claude_desktop_config.json (Claude Desktop) or .cursor/mcp.json (Cursor, Cline, Windsurf). The server must be enabled above for a client to connect.
help.vscode: Add this block to .vscode/mcp.json. VS Code uses "servers", not "mcpServers" — pasting a Cursor-style block here silently loads nothing.
help.opencode: Add this block to opencode.json (project) or ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (global).
